rules.statement: Give every player a named session landmark, progress, and truthful explicit exit without acquisition or utility navigation.
Use a named native no-JavaScript-safe compact disclosure before global links wrap into peer rows.
Keep primary discovery as static ordinary document navigation with truthful JavaScript-free fallbacks.
Give visual and text-keyboard hazard tasks equivalent discovery without claiming identical measurement.
Lead Practice with concrete task starts and place translated capacity diagnostics after those starts.
Preserve every fixed route identity, canonical path, and no-JavaScript purpose.
Expose Review through a normal static parent entry while retaining local and noindex semantics.
Separate learner tasks from utility and trust destinations instead of presenting every destination as a peer.
Require explicit or visibly neutral profile context and never silently substitute the first jurisdiction.
Keep human evidence none, human participant count zero, and every result labeled not human usability tested.
Preserve unofficial status, uncertainty, source support, local-data risk, security boundaries, and commit-before-reveal.
